title: Collecting rain water (sample one-pager)
body: This is a SAMPLE page so search can be tested. Replace it with a finished one-pager.
Idea: catch rain from a roof or tarp. Keep gutters clean. Store water in a closed, food-safe container.
Always treat rain from dirty roofs before you drink it. See the NO SAFE WATER card for boil and bleach steps (CDC).
Keywords: rain, catchment, barrel, tarp, gutter, drinking water, desert, monsoon.

title: Cool a burn with water (sample one-pager)
body: SAMPLE page. Production art should follow American Red Cross / WHO burn first aid.
Cool the burn with cool running water. Do not use ice, butter, or oil.
Cover loosely with a clean cloth. Get an adult. Call 911 for a big, deep, or face burn.
Keywords: burned, burn, blister, scald, sunburn, fire, first aid.

title: Food preservation notes (sample, not USDA text)
body: PLACEHOLDER. Do not can food from this page. Use official USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning.
When the real PDF is on the drive, this search app should open that file.
Topics the real guide covers: water-bath canning, pressure canning, jars, lids, acid foods, vegetables, meat.
Keywords: canning, jars, preserve, USDA, food storage, pantry.

title: Wiring a solar panel and charge controller (sample)
body: PLACEHOLDER. Wiring a panel wrong can start a fire or wreck a battery.
Production needs detailed pictures: panel, controller, battery, fuse, wire colors, and the safe hook-up order.
We can draw custom illustrations later. Do not use this sample to wire real equipment.
Keywords: solar, panel, charge controller, battery, 12 volt, fuse, off grid, power.
